content.what_it_is: MATLAB function solving the linear-wave dispersion relation omega^2 = g*k*tanh(k*h) for wavenumber k, used by plot_vertical_profile_paper.m in the FUNWAVE-TVD vertical_velocity_structure case. Signature k=wvnum_omvec(h,omega,g) (L1). Initial guess k=(omega^2/g)/sqrt(tanh(omega^2*h/g)) (L3) — the standard Eckart-type approximation. Newton-Raphson iteration (L5-L15): residual f=omega.^2-g*k.*tanh(k*h) (L9), derivative fp=-g*tanh(k*h)-g*(k*h)./cosh(k*h).^2 (L10), update kn=k-f./fp (L11), relative error=abs(kn-k)./k (L12), looping while any(abs(error) > 1e-6) (L8).
entities: wvnum_omvec — function(h, omega, g) returning wavenumber k (L1)
k — wavenumber iterate and return value (L3, L13)
error — relative change per iteration, init ones (L7)
fp — residual derivative d f/d k (L10)

equations.ref: initial guess for the dispersion solution
residual of omega^2 = g k tanh(kh)
derivative of residual with respect to k

unresolved: constants and params_defined are empty because the only numeric literal is the convergence tolerance .000001 embedded in the while condition (L8), which has no name in the file; per A-2 it is preserved in the verbatim span of L8.

The elementwise operators (.* ./) suggest vector omega/h support ('omvec'), but k*h uses the plain * operator (L9-L10), which is only elementwise for scalar h or scalar k; for vector h and vector k of the same orientation it still works elementwise only when one is scalar — a latent shape restriction not documented.
No iteration cap exists; non-convergence would loop forever (L8-L15).
